export_rights.summary: Not verified: BambooHR's Terms of Service (www.bamboohr.com/terms-of-service/) and DPA were not consulted, so no contractual export-rights statement is documented here. The vendor's API documentation consulted shows that account admins can self-serve extraction of employee records, custom-table history, employee/company files, and saved custom reports via the public API using an admin-generated API key.

routes.how: Datasets + Custom Reports APIs (base https://{companyDomain}.bamboohr.com/api/): GET /api/v1_2/datasets lists queryable datasets; GET /api/v1/datasets/{datasetName}/fields lists field descriptors (paginated, 500/page, max 1000); POST /api/v1/datasets/{datasetName}/data returns records for any field list with filters/sorting/grouping/aggregations (paginated, 500/page, max 1000). GET /api/v1/custom-reports lists saved custom reports (id + name); GET /api/v1/custom-reports/{reportId} executes a saved report and returns its rows as JSON. Legacy equivalent: POST /api/v1/reports/custom?format=CSV|XLS|PDF|JSON|XML generates an ad-hoc report of up to 400 fields (deprecated in favor of Datasets, but returns CSV/XLS directly and includes both Active and Inactive employees). Auth: API key as HTTP Basic username (password ignored, commonly 'x') or OAuth 2.0 authorization-code with per-resource scopes (Datasets/Custom Reports need the 'report' scope).
requires: API key generated in-app (profile menu > API Keys > Add New Key); the key inherits the generating user's permissions, so use an admin account for full coverage
Custom Reports endpoints return 403 if the required feature toggle is not enabled for the account
routes.rate_limits: Numeric limits are not published in the consulted docs; 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header is documented, and the SDK ships a RateLimitExceededException with exponential-backoff retry guidance.
gotchas: Datasets/Custom Reports pagination caps at 1000 records per page; out-of-range page numbers are silently clamped to the nearest valid page rather than erroring

In POST /v1/reports/custom, unknown field IDs or fields the caller lacks permission to view are silently omitted while the endpoint still returns 200 - diff the returned columns against the requested field list
POST /v1/reports/custom requires Content-Type exactly 'application/json' (any charset suffix causes the body to be parsed as XML and typically 400 Malformed XML)
Future hires carry status 'Inactive' in dataset queries; include Inactive in status filters to capture them
v1 dataset endpoints are deprecated with Deprecation/Link headers pointing at v1.2 successors

covers: custom-tables (jobInfo, compensation, employmentStatus, dependents, emergencyContacts, custom tables)
routes.how: REST Public API, two documented base-URL styles: https://api.bamboohr.com/api/gateway.php/{subdomain}/v1/... and https://{companyDomain}.bamboohr.com/api/v1/.... Key reads: GET /v1/employees/directory; GET /v1/employees/{id}?fields=... (field names discoverable via GET /v1/meta/fields); GET /v1/employees/{id}/tables/{table} per-employee table history; GET /v1/employees/all/tables/{table} returns a table for all employees in one call; GET /v1/employees/changed?since={ISO8601}[&type=inserted|updated|deleted] for incremental sync (any field or table change flags the employee); GET /api/v1/employees/changed/tables/{table} for changed table rows; GET /v1/time_off/requests; applicant-tracking and time-tracking endpoints under /api/v1/applicant_tracking/* and /api/v1/time_tracking/*. Auth: API key as HTTP Basic username with ignored password, or OAuth 2.0 with granular scopes.
requires: API key generated by an admin user (key permissions mirror the user's access level)
routes.rate_limits: Numeric limits not published in the consulted docs; 429 responses with Retry-After are documented across endpoints.
gotchas: GET /v1/employees/{id} returns only the fields you name - build the field list from /v1/meta/fields or you will silently miss custom fields
Restricted fields are filtered per caller permissions (newer endpoints surface a _restrictedFields array; older ones just omit values)
Response format is Accept-header sensitive; several legacy endpoints default to XML unless Accept: application/json is sent

routes.how: Reports built in the BambooHR UI (non-admins: My Reports; admins: Custom Reports under the My Reports and Company Reports tabs) are retrievable by API: hover over the report name in the UI to read its numeric ID from the URL, then GET /v1/reports/{id}?format=CSV|PDF|XLS|JSON|XML (deprecated but documented; case-insensitive format param) or GET /api/v1/custom-reports/{reportId} (JSON, paginated). This turns any UI-built report into a scriptable CSV/XLS export.
requires: Caller must have permission to view the report; report IDs are company-specific
gotchas: Standard (built-in) Reports are NOT available via the reports endpoint - only saved custom reports
The UI's default quick-filter shows only Active employees, while API report generation includes Inactive employees - row counts will differ
If the format query param is omitted, only five exact Accept header values work; anything else (including application/xml and */*) returns 404
In-UI download/export buttons for reports were not documented in the consulted sources - verify in-tenant

routes.how: Employee files: GET /v1/employees/{id}/files/view lists categories and file metadata (id, name, originalFileName, size, dateCreated) per employee; GET /v1/employees/{id}/files/{fileId} downloads the raw file content (Content-Disposition: attachment with original filename). Company files: GET /api/v1/files/view lists all company file categories and visible files; GET the company-file endpoint by fileId downloads content. Photos: GET /v1/employees/{id}/photo/{size}. Full extraction = iterate employees, list files, download each file.
requires: API key from a user with file-section view permissions (listings only include categories/files the caller may see)
gotchas: No bulk ZIP/archive download endpoint is documented - a full file export is one API call per file
Archived or soft-deleted employee files are excluded from listings and return 404 on download
File visibility is permission-scoped, so a non-admin key will silently miss files

routes.how: Metadata endpoints return JSON snapshots of account configuration: GET /v1/meta/fields (all standard + custom fields), GET /v1/meta/tables (table fields), GET /v1/meta/lists (list-field options), GET /v1/meta/users (user accounts), GET /v1/meta/time_off/policies and /v1/meta/time_off/types. Webhook configuration: GET /api/v1/webhooks (list), GET /api/v1/webhooks/{id}, plus /api/v1/webhooks/monitor_fields for monitorable fields.
routes.rate_limits: The webhook logs endpoint is explicitly rate-limited: when exceeded it returns HTTP 200 whose body is a 429-coded error object ('Over rate limit, please try again in 60 seconds') - check the response shape.
gotchas: These are read-only JSON snapshots for reference, not restorable import artifacts - no documented way to re-import them into another tenant
Approval workflows, permission/access-level definitions, and email templates have no documented export in the consulted sources
Webhook delivery logs cover only the last 14 days, max 200 entries

preservation_notes.attachments: Employee files and company files are extracted via the API only: list per employee with GET /v1/employees/{id}/files/view (and GET /api/v1/files/view for company files), then download each file individually by fileId (raw content with original filename). No bulk ZIP export is documented; archived/soft-deleted files 404 on download.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Partial: /v1/meta/fields, /v1/meta/tables, /v1/meta/lists, /v1/meta/users, and time-off policy/type metadata endpoints plus the webhooks API give JSON snapshots of field definitions, list options, users, and webhook config. These are reference snapshots, not restorable packages; workflow/approval and access-level configuration export is not documented in the consulted sources.

sources.title: BambooHR Public API OpenAPI specification (specs/public.yaml in BambooHR's official PHP SDK repository)
BambooHR official PHP SDK repository (README.md, AUTHENTICATION.md, GETTING_STARTED.md, COMMON_USE_CASES.md)

Unofficial OpenAPI definition of the BambooHR API (mirrors endpoint docs from documentation.bamboohr.com / www.bamboohr.com/api/documentation, incl. employees/all/tables, files, reports formats, basic-auth description)

notes: This recipe was built from BambooHR's own GitHub-published SDK repo - whose specs/public.yaml is the vendor-authored OpenAPI spec with full endpoint descriptions - supplemented by an unofficial OpenAPI mirror of the legacy gateway API docs. The following are honest unknowns to verify in-tenant: (1) any whole-account export/backup feature; (2) per-entity CSV/XLSX export buttons in the admin UI, including the report builder's in-UI export; (3) audit-trail/access-log export and its retention; (4) ToS/DPA export-rights language and any post-termination retrieval window (the ToS lives at www.bamboohr.com/terms-of-service/ and API terms at partners.bamboohr.com/bamboohr-api-terms-of-use/, neither consulted); (5) numeric API rate limits. Official API docs live at https://documentation.bamboohr.com/docs. The API surface itself is well-documented and admin-key Basic auth is trivial to script, so the Datasets/Custom Reports + per-file download combination should cover records, history tables, files, and config metadata even if no UI export exists.
research_caveats: The research environment's egress proxy blocked all bamboohr.com properties (www, help.bamboohr.com, documentation.bamboohr.com) and web search, so no live vendor page was fetched; the recipe rests on the vendor's GitHub-published SDK/OpenAPI spec plus an unofficial mirror of the legacy gateway API docs.
The Terms of Service (www.bamboohr.com/terms-of-service/) and API terms (partners.bamboohr.com/bamboohr-api-terms-of-use/) were unreachable, so contractual export-rights language was not consulted.
